modules.module_title: Maintain safe and secure working environment

pcs.pc_description: identify hazardous activities and the possible causes of risks or accidents in the workplace
report any breaches in health, safety and security policies and procedures to the designated person
conduct regular checks of the vehicle to avoid any accident
ensure that all the tools/equipment/spare parts are arranged as per standard procedures
follow standard procedures in case of emergency
make sure work area is kept clean and tidy

modules.module_title: Ensure work as per quality standards

pcs.pc_description: identify work requirements and comply with the same
identify work that fails the requirements, specified quality standards and ensure timely corrective action is taken
implement ways to manage time, resources and cost-effectively
take accountability for timely completion of the task
analyse and validate the problem accurately and communicate different possible solutions to the problem
identify processes where material and energy/electricity utilization can be optimized
identify possibilities of using renewable energy and environment friendly fuels
checks for spills/leakages around the work area periodically and take corrective actions or escalate to the appropriate authority if unable to rectify
ensure recyclable, non-recyclable and hazardous wastes are segregated as per SOP
ensure proper mechanism is followed while collecting and disposing of non-recyclable, recyclable and reusable waste

modules.module_title: Examine the vehicle before the trip

pcs.pc_description: inspect and conform the vehicle’s condition as per health and safety guidelines before starting the trip
ensure the vehicle meets the legal and compliance requirements like pollution test, load limit, etc.
perform routine maintenance checks on the vehicle for tyre pressure, fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) level, working of headlights and brakes, CNG cylinder valves etc.
check vehicle service record for any history of technical defects or immediate need for servicing like oil/filter change, etc.
prepare a to-do list for repair requirement, if any
record all deviations observed while carrying out checks
report actual or potential defects/deviations to the senior driver/owner/service supervisor
determine roadworthiness of the vehicle and use another vehicle if the current vehicle is found unfit
confirm all gauges and warning lights are functioning properly before moving the vehicle

modules.module_title: Drive the LMV conforming to the standard driving practices

pcs.pc_description: perform pre-driving activities like shoulder checking, adjusting IRVM/ ORVM and releasing of handbrakes, etc.
insert or press the ignition key/button to start the vehicle
coordinate gear changes, if any, with appropriate use of clutch/acceleration and steering control
maneuver the vehicle safely and responsibly while regulating the speed in all weather and road conditions by coordinating the operation of all controls
use the accelerator, steering control and brakes correctly for safe driving, stopping and parking the vehicle
ensure maximum fuel (Petrol/diesel/CNG) efficiency while driving
follow guidelines on the road while driving like avoiding excessive honking, driving on high beam, loud music, etc.
maintain a safe distance from other vehicles
ensure the vehicle is within the prescribed speed limits at all times and avoid rod hog
ensure proper parking at appropriate spots
adhere to local and state specific driving laws and traffic regulations, including overloading
turn off ignition at red lights or after parking the vehicle to enhance fuel efficiency
monitor and respond correctly to gauges, warning lights, CNG leakage etc. while driving
ensure to stop the vehicle at a safe place in case of any malfunction and turn off the ignition
carry out a quick diagnostic check
carry out minor adjustments or temporary repairs like replacement/top-up of oil, change of tyres/wipers, etc. if possible
report the exact nature of the problem to the supervisor to get appropriate help from the command office
take the vehicle to the service point for corrective action in case of major defect or accident

pcs.pc_description: report to the authorised person/owner on time as per the duty schedule and report reason for any absenteeism for the day
log into the system through the online application or manually signing the register to record attendance when starting the vehicle for the day
wear proper uniform that is allocated and report any deviations while carrying our duty
coordinate and communicate the status of previous journey completion
inform about taking a different route for pick up from the office/schools/shopping malls/clinic/ banks/ service station to the authorised person/owner

geographically understand different locations to perform a given tasks well in terms of alternatives route, searching address, landmarks, etc. and calculate pick up/drop time or delays in arriving at the destination
record and report parts/items needed for vehicle maintenance, like topping up water/coolent/brake fluid/power steering oil/engine oil within a certain interval of time

modules.module_title: Ensuring comfort to the passenger while driving

pcs.pc_description: confirm details of the passengers like name, booking ID, destination point etc before the pick up
take permission from passenger/owner to go on an alternate route in case of jams, accidents, road block etc. to save both time and fuel
handle account keeping for toll, parking charges, fines etc entrusted to the chauffer to avoid delay during the journey
inform the control room to arrange for another vehicle in case of vehicle break down or any emergency situation
explain about the inability for a vehicle to reach to the pick-up point
maintain vehicle in terms of cleanliness levels from inside and outside to meet the expectations of passenger/owner
keep sufficient stock levels of standard items in the vehicle e.g. drinking water, first aid kit, tissues, chargers, rain/ sun protection, reading material etc.
plan any new journey with the support of navigation system (GPS) for reaching out to the desired destination
operate infotainment system or entertainment media available inside the vehicle to the passenger as per the contract or passenger convenience
use advanced driving and safety features of vehicle like Cruise Control, ADAS etc. as per the requirement
inform about incidents, accidents, road rage, etc during the day, if any and also about minor altercation with passengers/owner members of the family
maintain a high standard of self-hygiene and cleanliness especially uniform and should not carry items having strong odor in the car (food, perfume etc)
understand specific requirements of the passenger in terms of entertainment, comfort and privacy
keep emergency helpline numbers, fire extinguisher and spare wheel in case of an emergency
